name: crdt-text
summary: A pure-Rust Logoot-style ordered-identifier sequence CRDT for collaborative plain-text / Markdown documents. Mountable into a constrained Ferrite app under the one-dependency rule: it names no crate of its own and uses only ferrite_app::serde / serde_json. Convergence is structural (a sorted map keyed by dense, globally unique position ids); deletes are tombstones; re-apply is idempotent. It is a text-sequence CRDT at Unicode-scalar granularity, NOT Yjs binary-format compatible.
